plain.li: [trait:Ascetic] A bed, a blanket and a hook for my coat. I don't need more.
[good,trait:Greedy] My room has the best rug in the colony. I checked the others to be sure.
[bad,trait:Greedy] I've seen the room down the hall. Mine has less in it, and I'm not letting that go.
[bad,trait:Jealous] Walked past the others' rooms on the way to bed. Every one of them is nicer than mine.
[trait:NightOwl] Shut the shutters tight so I could sleep through the morning. Woke at noon, rested.
[good,trait:Recluse] Shut my door at sundown and didn't open it again until morning. Bliss.
[trait:Undergrounder] No window, rock on three sides, and the quiet of a cellar. I slept straight through.
[old,bad] My room is too cold for old bones. I slept in my socks and still woke up stiff.
[old,good] At my age a good bed is worth more than a feast, and mine is a good bed.
[teen,bad] There's no privacy in my room. People knock and walk in at the same time.
[teen,good] Kept my door shut all evening and drew on the wall behind the bed, where it's hidden.
[lowtech,good] Laid fresh rushes on my floor and went to sleep with the smell of them.
[lowtech,bad] The wind gets through the chinks in my wall. I stuffed them with moss, and it found new ones.
[winter,bad] My room never warms up. I can see my breath when I blow out the candle.
[winter,good] Snow piled against the wall outside, and my room stayed warm all night.
[summer,bad] My room holds the day's heat all night. I ended up sleeping on the floor where it's cooler.
[rain,good] Rain on the roof all night, and not a drop on me.
[!lowtech,good] Read in bed under my own lamp until the book fell onto my chest.
[trait:Ascetic] All this decoration is wasted on me. A swept floor would do.
[good,trait:Greedy] There's a fine new statue in the hall. It would look better in my room.
[bad,trait:Pyromaniac] The rubbish heap behind the storeroom is getting big. It would burn nicely.
[bad,skill:Artistic] Every wall here is bare. Give me some paint and a week.
[good,skill:Artistic] Studied the carving in the hall for a long time today. I'd have done the hands differently.
[good,skill:Plants] The flower beds came up well. I'd move the roses back a pace, but they look fine.
[old,good] When I was young, a place like this would have been the finest house in the valley.
[teen,bad] This place is ugly and old and smells like feet.
[spring,good] Everything's in flower around the walls. I walked to work slowly to make it last.
[fall,good] The trees around the colony have gone red and gold. I stood and looked before going in.
[winter,bad] Mud, gray snow and soot. Winter makes the whole place look tired.
[afterraid,bad] Still bloodstains by the gate from the fight. I scrubbed some of it before supper.
[lowtech,good] Someone carved patterns into the posts by the door. I traced them with my finger on the way in.
[!lowtech,bad] Scrap and broken parts piled by the workshop for days. It looks like a junkyard.
[winter] Long winter evening. {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked for hours with our feet to the stove.
[spring] {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat on the wall in the spring sun and talked about the people we used to be.
[rain] Rain all evening, so {OTHER_nameDef} and I sat in the doorway and talked until it stopped.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} talked to me like a grown-up today and asked what I want to be.
[old] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to hear about the old days. I told {OTHER_objective} more than I meant to.
[trait:Recluse] I don't usually talk to anyone for this long. {OTHER_nameDef} made it easy.
[trait:TooSmart] {OTHER_nameDef} is sharper than I gave {OTHER_objective} credit for. We argued about the stars until the candle went out.
[skill:Social] Got {OTHER_nameDef} talking about {OTHER_possessive} old life tonight. All it took was one good question.
[grieving] Talked with {OTHER_nameDef} about the one we lost. It's the first time I've said the name out loud in days.
[newcomer] {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me tonight and told me how things work here, and who to watch out for.
[afterraid] After the fight, {OTHER_nameDef} and I talked about how close it was. We kept our voices down.
[lowmood] I'd been low for days. Talking with {OTHER_nameDef} tonight helped more than sleep has.
[winter] Thick hot soup on a cold day. I held the bowl until my hands stopped aching.
[summer] Supper outside in the warm evening, roast meat and greens, with the bugs singing.
[trait:Gourmand] Two bowls of stew and the heel of the bread. I'd have gone back for a third if anyone had looked away.
[trait:Gourmand] Supper was good. I've already started thinking about breakfast.
[trait:Ascetic] The meal was fine, more than fine. I'd have been happy with half.
[trait:Greedy] I took the bowl with the most meat in it before the others sat down.
[skill:Cooking] Ate someone else's cooking tonight. Not bad. I'd have used less salt.
[old] My teeth aren't what they were, so a soft hot supper is a kindness. This was a kind one.
[teen] Ate three helpings and was hungry again by bedtime.
[hurt] Ate supper in bed. Someone had cut the meat up small for me.
[afterraid] The first proper meal since the attack. We ate it without saying much.
[lowtech] Roast meat and flatbread off the fire tonight. The fat ran down my wrist.
[spacer] Real cooked food again, not ration packs. I ate slowly.
